about: Donald R. Kirk is an attorney who represents clients in the Tampa, Florida area. Donald Kirk is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2008 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Donald Kirk chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of Florida Levin College of Law and graduated in 1996. Donald Kirk passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1997.
He represents clients with Bankruptcy: Business issues in Florida. He also represents clients with Business Litigation issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Donald Kirk has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
